title: Why HDR Games Still Need Tone Mapping
description:
An HDR scene can contain more luminance than one real display can reproduce. This short animation shows how tone mapping fits highlights, mid-tones and dark detail into the screen's measured brightness range instead of simply clipping everything above its limit.

Sources:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct2d/hdr-tone-map-effect
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/gaming/gdk/docs/reference/system/xdisplay/structs/xdisplayhdrmodeinfo
https://vesa.org/about-displayhdr/

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
